summary: Completed the first scenario-complete Teledyne Technologies common-stock review using current SEC primary evidence and the canonical 2026-08-04 upper-Bollinger trigger. Record Q2 orders, sales, operating profit, funded backlog, margin expansion, cash flow and debt repayment support a high-quality thesis, but the deterministic assessment recorded a Hold rating, Watch portfolio action, 86 quality, medium confidence, and USD 506/USD 675/USD 870 bear/base/bull fair values with USD 681.50 probability-weighted fair value against USD 684.760009765625. Allocation remains ineligible because expected return, base return, bear/base and expected/bear payoff, margin of safety, and the accepted-relationship gate do not pass; no conviction strategy, signal, paper order, issue, or follow-up operation was created.

evidence.claim: Teledyne's SEC quarterly report for Q2 2026 reported USD 1,662.5 million net sales, USD 251.7 million attributable net income, USD 5.37 diluted EPS, 20.0% operating margin, USD 549.2 million first-half operating cash flow, USD 60.2 million first-half capital expenditure, USD 340.1 million cash, USD 2,027.0 million total debt, and 46,355,673 shares outstanding on July 15.

The SEC-filed issuer release reported record quarterly orders, sales and operating profit, approximately USD 5.0 billion funded backlog, USD 284.7 million Q2 free cash flow, 1.1x quarter-end leverage, and raised full-year 2026 GAAP and non-GAAP EPS guidance to USD 20.73-20.99 and USD 24.45-24.65.

The canonical alert measured a 16.39% adjusted-close increase from 2026-07-07 through 2026-08-04 to USD 684.760009765625 and a close 3.68% above the USD 660.46 upper Bollinger band; RSI was 75.05 and volume was not anomalous. The review treated this as verified post-results fundamental confirmation but unfavorable entry timing rather than a paper-buy signal.

Deterministic assessment version 2 derived USD 681.50 probability-weighted fair value, -0.4761% expected return, -0.3571% confidence-adjusted expected return, USD 540 buy-below price, -1.4459% margin of safety, Hold canonical rating, Watch portfolio action, Watch conviction tier, and allocation ineligibility with complete threshold-frontier reasons.

daily_report_items: TDY security review completed: Q2 sales rose 9.8%, attributable net income rose 19.9%, operating margin expanded to 20.0%, management reported record orders and approximately USD 5.0 billion funded backlog, and Q2 free cash flow reached USD 284.7 million. Scenario fair values are USD 506/USD 675/USD 870 against USD 684.76. Deterministic rating is Hold and portfolio action Watch; the 4 August upper-Bollinger breakout confirms strong post-results expectations but does not overcome slightly negative modeled return, unfavorable bear asymmetry, medium confidence, premium valuation, or the missing accepted relationship. No strategy, signal, or paper order was created.
